program:

program:
app "Age" calendar plum
setting born date = today "Date of birth"
let yrs = year(today) - year(born) - if(month(today) * 100 + monthday(today) < month(born) * 100 + monthday(born), 1, 0)
yrs "years" big
"Days lived" today - born head
"Next birthday in" addmonths(born, 12 * (yrs + 1)) - today "days" bold
"Weeks lived" floor((today - born) / 7) faint
describe:
Age, in the plum colours.
You can change: "Date of birth": date, starts at today.
Works out:
- yrs is the year of today minus the year of born minus 1 when the month of today times 100 plus the day of the month of today is less than the month of born times 100 plus the day of the month of born, otherwise 0.
Shows:
- text: yrs, "years".
- text: "Days lived", today minus born.
- text: "Next birthday in", born moved by 12 times the result of yrs plus 1 months minus today, "days".
- text: "Weeks lived", the result of today minus born divided by 7 rounded down.
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Business costs" bag plum
table cost what text, amount money, note text?
let spent = sum(cost.amount month)
setting budget money = 200000 "Monthly budget"
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form cost
daybars last 7 days, sum(cost.amount on it)
list cost month by day
remind "Add today's expenses" at 12:00, 18:00
describe:
Business costs, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- cost: what: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 200000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of cost this month.
Shows:
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a cost.
- a bar chart of the total amount of cost on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of cost this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Add today's expenses" at 12:00, 18:00 every day.
hurried_style: all lowercase, no punctuation, 2 to 8 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:

table hifz surah text, status pick New|Revising|Strong = New, last date
"Revise today" head
each hifz where last < today - 7 sort last as h
  row card tap edit h
    h.surah bold grow
    (today - h.last) "days ago" color warn
if count(hifz where last < today - 7) = 0
  "All revised in the last week." faint color good

  row tap edit h swipe remove h
    h.surah grow
    h.status faint
form hifz

  - a group; a tap opens the hifz for editing:
    - text: the surah of the hifz.
    - text: the result of today minus the last of the hifz, "days ago".
- if how many hifz entries where last is less than today minus 7 is 0:

app "Table tennis" ball mint
table pt side pick Left|Right
let l = count(pt where side = Left)

grid 2 gap 2
  stack card align center pad 3 fill soft tap add pt side = Left
    draw 20, 8
      circle 10, 4, 3 fill if(serve = 0, accent, soft)
    l big
  stack card align center pad 3 fill soft tap add pt side = Right
    draw 20, 8
      circle 10, 4, 3 fill if(serve = 1, accent, soft)
    r big
if (l >= 11 or r >= 11) and abs(l - r) >= 2
  if(l > r, "Left", "Right") "wins!" big color good
button "Undo" tap remove last(pt)
button "New game" tap remove all pt

program:
app "Supplies" box ink
table item name text, qty num 0.., need num 0.. = 3
screen stock "Stock" box
  each item sort name as i
    row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
      i.name bold grow color if(i.qty < i.need, warn, ink)
      button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
      i.qty bold
      button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
  form item, "Add item"
screen buy "To buy" cart
  count(item where qty < need) "things to buy" big
  each item where qty < need sort name as i
    row card
      i.name grow
      i.need - i.qty "more" bold
      button "Bought" tap set i.qty = i.need
describe:
Supplies, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; need: number, at least 0, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Stock":
  - for each item sorted by name:
    - a group; a tap opens the item for editing; a swipe removes the item, with undo:
      - text: the name of the item.
      - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item minus 1.
      - text: the qty of the item.
      - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the qty of the item plus 1.
  - a form to add a item.
- a screen "To buy":
  - text: how many item entries where qty is less than need, "things to buy".
  - for each item where qty is less than need sorted by name:
    - text: the name of the item.
    - text: the need of the item minus the qty of the item, "more".
    - a button "Bought"; a tap sets the qty of the item to the need of the item.

program:
app "First aid kit" pill plum
table supply name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(supply, it.qty <= it.low)
short "supplies running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each supply where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(supply, it.qty * it.price) faint
form supply
describe:
First aid kit, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- supply: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Home, Work, Other; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the supply have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "supplies running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each supply where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the supply for editing; a swipe removes the supply, with undo:
    - text: the name of the supply.
    - text: the kind of the supply.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the supply.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the supply to the qty of the supply minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the supply.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the supply to the qty of the supply plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the supply.
- a form to add a supply.

program:
app "Party" gift plum
setting limit money = 80000 "Budget"
table guest name text, coming bool
table todo what text, done bool
table cost what text, amount money
screen g "Guests" users
  "Coming" count(guest where coming = yes) "of" count(guest) big
  each guest sort name as x
    row card
      x.name grow
      toggle x.coming
  form guest
screen t "Tasks" check
  goal count(todo where done = yes), max(count(todo), 1), "tasks done"
  each todo as x
    row card
      toggle x.done
      x.what grow
  form todo
screen b "Budget" wallet
  goal sum(cost.amount all), limit, "spent", ""
  form cost
  list cost
describe:
Party, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- guest: name: text; coming: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- todo: what: text; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- cost: what: text; amount: money. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Budget": money, starts at 80000.
Shows:
- a screen "Guests":
  - text: "Coming", how many guest entries where coming is yes, "of", how many guest entries.
  - for each guest sorted by name:
    - text: the name of the guest.
    - a tick box for the coming of the guest.
  - a form to add a guest.
- a screen "Tasks":
  - how many todo entries where done is yes out of the larger of how many todo entries and 1 with a progress bar, labelled "tasks done".
  - for each todo:
    - a tick box for the done of the todo.
    - text: the what of the todo.
  - a form to add a todo.
- a screen "Budget":
  - the total amount of cost out of limit with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
  - a form to add a cost.
  - a list of cost; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
